$description: Sticky (platform/components/Sticky, library wave 3): a sticky or fixed region's layer, surface, stuck shadow and safe-area insets.

sticky-z-index.$description: Sticky: the sticky layer, above the content that scrolls under it and below menus and overlays.

sticky-background.$description: Sticky: the region's surface, so content scrolling under it never shows through.

sticky-stuck-shadow.$description: Sticky: the shadow (with its hairline) that separates the region from the content under it while it is stuck.

sticky-transition-duration.$description: Sticky: how fast the shadow appears when the region sticks.

sticky-transition-easing.$description: Sticky: the easing of the shadow.

sticky-safe-area-top.$description: Sticky: the top padding of a top region with safeArea (the notch, the status bar).

sticky-safe-area-bottom.$description: Sticky: the bottom padding of a bottom region with safeArea (the home indicator).

sticky-safe-area-start.$description: Sticky: the start padding with safeArea (a landscape notch).

sticky-safe-area-end.$description: Sticky: the end padding with safeArea.
